a6923620-267d-5129-b8c4-cd9b1e1a1e7b.content: The user used an accessible entrance at a clinic in December 2024.

fb0e1d1f-0ef5-5214-b6d7-f6ca5c68f582.content: On a day snow had accumulated and blocked the main-entrance ramp, the user went to a side entrance.

4cb45120-4376-5c7b-ae92-faa9e4b9330c.content: The user learned on site that the elevator was under inspection and delayed the appointment.

479f4434-879c-5335-b0c9-c0bfa19ecdcd.content: The day before the next visit, the user called to check whether the elevator would be operating.

0f2c78a7-8f92-573d-af8a-a360ceb77b24.content: The user waited for their turn in front of a ticket machine near the waiting chairs.

7b9197ac-4263-5169-8d3b-d34f5d893d36.content: On a day the user waited in a corridor without chairs, they leaned against the wall and changed position several times.

7b0b7571-f29c-56e5-a27a-82d69a4a6982.content: On a day their older sister accompanied them, the user found a place to sit immediately after reception.

e9515d6b-10d9-579f-abf7-5030db64218a.content: Reception staff expect that a first-time visitor may ask where the accessible entrance is.

8e57141d-c603-56cd-ab9e-c14b4e944b45.content: The local agent cannot infer the user's condition from a record of using an accessible route alone.

a6076438-307c-56fe-9d2c-848181846ce5.content: Snow accumulation and snow-removal work can temporarily block an entrance route used under ordinary conditions.
